title: Signals Intelligence/Ground Electromagnetic Warfare Officer (I) (LtCol to 2ndLt) NMOS (0202), DIR INTEL
raw_text:
5. MOS 0206, Signals Intelligence/Ground Electromagnetic Warfare Officer (I)
(LtCol to 2ndLt) NMOS (0202), DIR INTEL

    a. Summary. Signals Intelligence/Ground Electromagnetic Warfare
(SIGINT/EW) Officers command and/or lead SIGINT/EW units in tactical
information gathering operations and activities in support of identified
collection requirements. SIGINT/EW Officers advise commanders and staffs on
the employment of SIGINT and EW assets in support of information gathering
and information operations and activities. Through the Intelligence Officer,
they also support the overall intelligence effort of the command.

       b.   Prerequisites

            (1) SCI prescreen interview by HQMC SSO prior to selection.

            (2) Must submit to a counterintelligence scope polygraph examination.

        (3) Completed the Tactical Intelligence Officer Course (TIOC)
(N46CU22).

        (4) Security requirement: must meet sensitive compartmented
information (SCI) eligibility guidelines based on a single scope background
investigation (SSBI)/T5 investigation.




                                          1-11                       Enclosure (1)
 1105                                                           NAVMC 1200.1L



        (5) Intelligence MOS Marines are required to have a Defense Language
Aptitude Battery (DLAB) test score on file in their official military
personnel file (OMPF). Intelligence MOS Marines that score above 100 on the
DLAB may be designated to attend formal language training. There is no
minimum DLAB score required. Intelligence officers will be administered the
DLAB before being assigned the 0206 PMOS.

       c.   Requirements

        (1) Complete the Signals Intelligence Officer Course (SIOC)
(N46CUK2), Marine Corps Intelligence Schools, Marine Corps Detachment Dam
Neck, VA.

        (2) Upon completion of this course, Marine Corps Detachment Dam Neck
will assign PMOS 0202 and this NMOS to the Marine.

    d. Duties. For a complete listing of duties and tasks, refer to
reference (g), Intelligence Training and Readiness Manual.

    e. Related Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) Title and Code.
Command and Control Center Officers 55-1015.

       f.   Related Military Skill.   None.

nlx_method: NLx employer-demand profiles; private-only ownership unverified. Six-digit profiles pool specialty weighted task incidences after the existing review exclusion mask and five-job task-support floor; destination SOCs require 200 postings and nonzero tasks. Military profiles use binary accepted task presence and the same NLx reference RCA weights as civilian profiles: reciprocal positive task shares (zero weight for reference-absent tasks) of pooled retained support-five NLx weighted incidences across 1,016 reference specialties (912 eligible comparison candidates), sqrt(q * rca_weight), then L2 normalization and cosine. No military crosswalk codes enter the task ranking. All positive top-20 results retained; zero-similarity destinations are not recommendations. Shared field/rating duties are included; general Naval Standards remain separate by paygrade. Summary compares non-future individual source entries (versions can repeat) with nonempty reference sets; grouped, future and general-standard entries remain in all outputs. Hit@k is the fraction with at least one reference SOC recovered; ties are averaged exactly. References outside NLx remain in denominators. DMDC reference status is from July 2024, not current 2026 status.
